title: feat(video): add Fal MiniMax H3 Max video model
author: fisventurous
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15507

- Adds `minimax/minimax-h3-max` via fal for text, start/end frames, and reference media, with 5/10/15-second durations at 480p/768p/1080p and synchronized audio.
- Bills fal’s reported units at its current endpoint rate, including reference-media charges, while preserving output duration separately; rejects invalid provider pricing or usage.
- Displays provider-cost pricing without marking the model free. Keeps the existing H3 and Turbo paths unchanged.
- Validated locally: 406 regression tests, Gen and Enter type checks, and Biome. Four real generations matched fal billing records, wallet deductions, and Tinybird events (0.125, 0.4, 1.064, and 1.2 Pollen); disconnect/rejoin and completed-cache replay caused no duplicate execution or debit.
- Links the 3-Pollen quest for @fisventurous. After merge, the author checks and claims the reward on the Quests page.

gist.headline: H3 gets a longer take
gist.blurb: MiniMax H3 Max can make a little movie from a prompt, a pair of frames, or reference media. It brings synchronized audio along, too.
gist.summary: Added `minimax/minimax-h3-max` via fal for text, start/end-frame, and reference-media video generation, with 5-, 10-, or 15-second outputs at 480p, 768p, or 1080p and synchronized audio.
gist.impact: Users can choose H3 Max without changing the existing H3 or Turbo paths, see provider-cost pricing, and have Pollen charged from fal's reported usage, including reference media.
gist.visual_concept: Depict H3 Max as a cozy pixel-art film workstation rather than inventing a model mascot: a prompt card, two film frames, and a reference picture feed a small screen showing a blooming garden video with a music note. Polli wears a tiny director's beret and helps arrange the frames; lime-green code-plants grow around the desk.
